title: Apply an action to every item
summary: Julia: Apply an action to every item. Multiply each value by 3.
introduction: A dot applies an operation element by element. Here each number is doubled.
learningObjectives: Apply an action to every item with Julia

blocks.text: Install Julia. Save each example as lesson.jl and run julia lesson.jl, or paste it into the Julia REPL.
Apply an action to every item

blocks.title: Apply an action to every item

blocks.text: The dotted multiplication applies to each item. The results are 4 and 6.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The dot is important when you want item-by-item operations.
